title: Tarazona 1500 (Missale Tirasonense): complete strict Canon Missae constituent — complete constituent extent and page account
scope: Complete strict Eucharistic Canon of the 13 February 1500 Tarazona-use missal printed at Pamplona by Arnaldo Guillén de Brocar (Bizkaia INC-35, PDF pp. 350-354): from the woodcut initial Te igitur at PDF p. 350 col. 1 through Et uoce alta dicit. Per omnia secula seculorum. R. Amen. at PDF p. 354 col. 1 immediately before Oremus preceptis salutaribus / Pater noster. Includes all printed headings, action rubrics, red N. placeholders and 26 printed crosses (✠) under declared selective Latin reading normalization.

pages.description: Library card, arms, calendar, local-use instruction, Temporale, Mass preparation and Prefaces/Sanctus through PDF p. 349.
PDF p. 350 (sig. pp): Te igitur, Oratio pro uiuis / Memento, Infra actionem / Communicantes through Iohannis.
PDF p. 351: completion of Communicantes, Hanc igitur, Quam oblationem, Qui pridie (Hoc est enim corpus meum.), and start of Simili modo.
PDF p. 352: completion of Simili modo (Hic est enim calix...), Unde et memores, Supra que, and Supplices through omni ✠ be-.
PDF p. 353: completion of Supplices, Memento defunctorum, Nobis quoque (with Hic non dicitur: Amen:), Per quem, and Per ipsum.
PDF p. 354 col. 1 top lines 1-3: Et uoce alta dicit. Per omnia secula seculorum. R. Amen.; Oremus / Pater noster / Libera nos below excluded.
Post-Canon Ordinary, Sanctorale, Commons, votive Masses and Pamplona 1500 colophon (p. 656).
